verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs describe an official, hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to Mixpanel data. Once connected, an agent can query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language, and documented tools include Create-Dashboard. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and documented setup/authentication details for connecting specific agent clients.
